snippet.title: EIGENGRAU: Dream Book Full Walkthrough (ALL ENDINGS)
snippet.description:
EIGENGRAU: Dream Book is an RPG Maker game inspired by 2010s horror RPGM horror games.. and is a romantic comedy. It's a short adventure with beautiful graphics and 8 endings, that you can finish in half an hour. 

It's FREE on itch.io. this video was made for people who can't afford to play this game for any reasons/stuck in game.  I highly advise you to play it for yourself!
https://cyber-pchela.itch.io/eigengrau-dream-book
